WITH station_usage AS (
  SELECT observatories.observstation, observatories.lunarstage, AVG(telescopes.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes
  JOIN observatories ON telescopes.observstation = observatories.observstation
  GROUP BY observatories.observstation, observatories.lunarstage
), phase_summary AS (
  SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS station_count
  FROM station_usage
  GROUP BY lunarstage
)
SELECT lunarstage, avg_bandusagepct, station_count,
       CAST(station_count AS REAL) / SUM(station_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
FROM phase_summary;

assumptions.assumption: Count each matched observatory station once within its lunar phase; stations without any matching telescope are excluded. The overall total for the share is the number of such stations.
